name: China Satellite Network Group

overview.value: China SatNet (中国星网) is a state-owned enterprise established in April 2021 that reports directly to SASAC. It operates the Guowang low-Earth-orbit satellite internet constellation, which is being deployed to provide national broadband, government, and military services.
